ja: 闇 夜 を 揺 る が す 咆 哮 ―
ＲＧ人造人間エヴァンゲリオン初号機が夜間戦闘をイメージしたカラーリングで商品化。
特徴的な色合いを成形色と特殊素材にて再現。印象的な劇中シーンを再現可能なエフェクト類も付属。
●　夜間戦闘をイメージしたカラーリングを再現
『ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版：序』でも印象的な夜間戦闘時のカラーリングを成形色で再現。
紫の外装部分にはメタリック成形色を採用し、緑の外装部分は特殊素材を用いる事で、夜間での発光を再現。
特殊素材
初号機の印象的な緑の外装部に“蓄光素材”を用いる事で、夜間での発光を再現。
劇中の闇夜に浮かび上がる緑の発光イメージをお楽しみいただけます。
●　Ａ.Ｔ.フィールドエフェクトパーツ、専用ハンドパーツが付属
劇中でも印象的なＡ.Ｔ.フィールドを引き裂くシーンを再現できるエフェクトパーツやハンドパーツが付属。

en: A roar that shakes the dark night.
The first RG Android Evangelion unit is commercialized with coloring inspired by night battles.
The characteristic colors are reproduced using molded colors and special materials. Effects that can reproduce impressive scenes from the play are also included.
● Reproduces coloring inspired by night battles
The coloring during the night battle, which is also impressive in ``Evangelion: New Theatrical Version: Introduction'', is reproduced with molded colors.
The purple exterior part uses metallic molding color, and the green exterior part uses a special material to reproduce the luminescence at night.
special material
By using ``phosphorescent material'' on the first model's impressive green exterior, it reproduces the luminescence at night.
Enjoy the green luminous image that appears in the dark night of the movie.
● A.T. field effect parts and special hand parts are included.
Comes with effect parts and hand parts that can reproduce the impressive scene in the movie where the A.T. field is torn apart.
Attached weapons: progressive knife / pallet rifle
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS, ABS, PP, PVC, PET
・No adhesive is used for assembly
